verdict.rationale: Dagster's asset framework and its dbt/Airbyte/Fivetran/dlt integrations imply pipelines can load into various warehouses/lakes via pluggable tooling, but the evidence pack has no direct mention of first-class I/O managers or connectors for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, or object storage, nor documentation of the 'swap destination without changing pipeline code' abstraction the story requires. missing for 10: explicit warehouse/lake connector docs (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, S3), evidence of I/O-manager-based portability across these targets, and any hands-on confirmation of switching destinations without code changes.
